meta.name: datamol
meta.description: Pythonic wrapper around RDKit with simplified interface and sensible defaults. Preferred for standard drug discovery including SMILES parsing, standardization, descriptors, fingerprints, clustering, 3D conformers, parallel processing. Returns native rdkit.Chem.Mol objects. For advanced control or custom parameters, use rdkit directly.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 简化药物研发中的分子分析工作
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在做药物研发,常需要用代码处理化学数据。
copy.tagline_en: Simplify molecular analysis in drug research and development
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work in drug discovery and want a friendlier way to process molecular data.

howto.what: 处理分子数据时,Claude 能用 datamol 解析 SMILES、标准化结构、计算描述符与指纹、聚类、生成 3D 构象,并做批量并行处理,返回原生的 RDKit 分子对象。
howto.when: 当你要求做常规药物发现任务,如解析 SMILES、计算分子描述符、生成 3D 构象等时接管;需要自定义参数或高级控制时改用 rdkit。

say.text: 把这批 SMILES 解析成分子并标准化
say.note: 返回标准化后的分子与 SMILES

say.text: 计算这些分子的描述符和指纹,再聚类
给这个分子生成 50 个 3D 构象并算 SASA
say.note: 返回带构象的 RDKit 分子

howto.what_en: When handling molecule data, Claude can parse SMILES, standardize structures, compute descriptors and fingerprints, cluster, generate 3D conformers, and run batched parallel jobs, returning native RDKit Mol objects.
howto.when_en: Triggers on routine drug-discovery work such as parsing SMILES, computing descriptors, or generating 3D conformers. For custom parameters or advanced control, it defers to rdkit directly.

say_en.text: Parse these SMILES into molecules and standardize them.
Compute descriptors and fingerprints for these molecules, then cluster them.
Generate 50 3D conformers for this molecule and compute SASA.
say_en.note: Returns an RDKit molecule with conformers.
